calibration.method: Neutral first-sheet anatomy measured from natural ear top y43 to contact plane y574 =531px. Transfer this standing reference ONCE per sheet by median connected head-plate width in manually reviewed frontal head ROI, excluding tail and whisker protrusions. All frames on each sheet retain this one isotropic reference; no individual pose height fitting. Head projection differences are retained. Provisional image calibration, scene ratio remains separate.

frames.support_notes: Measured drawn support under the visible feet; x is the midpoint of the combined bottom-foot contour contact region over the final 12 native rows at alpha128, visually checked against the two feet (or the planted foot for cheer). It is a registered contact proxy, not a canvas centre or a new body scale. The independent observer retains its offset from this declared support point.
